definitions.gloss: sweeping popularity; dominating; taking by storm
definitions.explanation: To spread widely and dominate, like wind bending grass. Almost exclusively used in the set phrase 一世を風靡する (to take the world by storm).

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦バンド→バンド：05508_bando⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{一世|いっせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{風靡|ふうび}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: That band took the world by storm.

examples.japanese: 1990⟦{年代|ねんだい}→年代：03533_nendai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{一世|いっせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{風靡|ふうび}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ファッション→ファッション：11167_fasshon⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{再|ふたた}び→再び：03600_futatabi⟧⟦{注目|ちゅうもく}→注目：03483_chuumoku⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Fashion that swept the world in the 1990s is attracting attention again.

examples.japanese: ⟦かつて→かつて：10303_katsute⟧{一世|いっせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{風靡|ふうび}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{歌手|かしゅ}→歌手：00197_kashu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{引退|いんたい}→引退：01848_intai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}→発表：03562_happyou⟧し、⟦ファン→ファン：10065_fan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{間|あいだ}→間：00914_aida⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{衝撃|しょうげき}→衝撃：08678_shougeki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{走|はし}った→走る：00519_hashiru⟧。
examples.english: A singer who once took the world by storm announced retirement, sending shockwaves among fans.

notes:
USAGE: {風靡|ふうび} is almost always used in the fixed phrase {一世|いっせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{風靡|ふうび}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to take the world by storm, to sweep the era). It is rarely used outside this expression.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {一世|いっせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{風靡|ふうび}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to dominate an era, to become hugely popular)
- ⟦{世間|せけん}→世間：03299_seken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{風靡|ふうび}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to sweep through society)

The literal meaning is "wind bending (grass)" — the kanji {靡|なび}く means to sway or bend in the wind. The image is of a powerful trend that bends everything in its path, like wind flattening grass across a field. This word is primarily used in the past tense to describe phenomena that already swept through, often with a nostalgic tone.
